transcript:
Yo aaj hai day nine aur sixty day of the challenge ka aaj ke andar main baat karunga basically kya hua kal aur kyon mujhe itna time laga, maine ek story agar koi followers hai jinhone meri story dekhi rahegi main Final Cut Pro pe switch ho gaya wapas. I didn't like DaVinci that much, toh Final Cut Pro pe jab main switch hua tab wahan pe jab English captions ya subtitles jo mujhe banane pad rahe the wo kaafi kaafi hard ho raha tha, toh basically maine khud se ek program likha hua hai. Although main AI models use kar raha hoon behind the scenes main aapko wo batata hoon mere PC pe abhi theek hai chalo. To basically main yahan pe maine code kiya hua hai mere khud ke scripts likhi hui hai aur main yahan se SRT file generate karta hoon. Ab main basically audio wave se SRT file generate karta hoon, JSON file hai meri. Ab main ya to one liner main kar sakta hoon ya two liner YouTube video ya reels ya shorts vagaira inke liye to main abhi filhaal. One liner aapko dikhata hoon right, ye ho gaya mere generated caption yahan pe, yahan se pehle se open hai DaVinci Resolve aur ye dekh sakte ho. To ab se mujhe bas khali ye SRT file uthani hai aur seedha FCP mein daal deni hai.
Ab main sochta hoon ki iski wajah se main thoda shayad divert ho raha hoon jo mera main focus hai AWS ke upar certificate lena AWS cloud ops engineer associate jo mera padhna hai. To abhi main uske upar zyada wapas focus karne lagunga, iske upar bhi kar raha hoon aur side by side thodi aur plugins wagairah subtitles thoda FCPW pe kaam karunga, but let's see how it goes aur kal ke liye thoda rest lene wala hoon.
